metaTitle: P.L.A.W — a training log for tennis
metaDescription: Plan, log and analyze tennis practices. For coaches, for players, parents and managers, and for federations, clubs and academies.
title: Plan. Log. Analyze. Win.
subtitle: A training log for tennis. Pick the one that fits you.
consumerText: Plan practices, log drills right there on the court and see analytics of what the player actually worked on.
followerText: Follow the practices of the player a coach's code connects you to — which drills, how long, and what is planned next. The history stays in your account.
orgText: Several coaches under one roof, a control panel for the head coach across the whole organization, and training data that belongs to the organization — not to the coach.
